messages:
maria-plat: Quick sync — I'm drafting the routing policy for tiered fallbacks and quota enforcement. Need engineering + product input before I put this in the Console mockups.
jon: ok — what are the hard requirements? do we hard reject when quota exceeded or degrade to slower/cheaper variant?
alex: leaning toward 2-stage: soft quota => throttled + header warning, hard quota => reject. cheap fallback model before throttling if latency budget allows.
maria-plat: exactly. UX should show a clear reason in console: 'soft quota warning' vs 'hard quota blocked'. product wants fallback to cheaper model to avoid visible errors for pro customers.
sam-product: pro customers pay for reliability — prefer automatic fallback to a compatible variant, plus an opt-out in tenant settings for strict enforcement. free tier can be more aggressive.
jon: compatibility is tricky. fallback must preserve interface (same tokenizer, same response format). If we fall back from a 16k context model to 8k, we need automatic truncation + telemetry.
alex: here's a straw config I'm testing in staging:
```yaml
policy_version: 1
tiers:
  free:
    primary: rdm-7b-8k
    fallback: rdm-7b-q4
    soft_quota_tokens_per_day: 500000
    hard_quota_tokens_per_day: 750000
    fallback_behavior: allow_then_throttle
  pro:
    primary: rdm-13b-16k
    fallback: rdm-13b-ptq
    soft_quota_tokens_per_day: 5000000
    hard_quota_tokens_per_day: 7000000
    fallback_behavior: fallback-first
```
jon: can we keep policy small and expressive? maybe a boolean for 'fallback_before_reject' + numeric soft/hard? also need region overrides.
sudha: telemetry requirements: we must emit per-tenant metrics: tokens_consumed, percent_fallback, fallback_latency_delta, soft_quota_warn_count, hard_quota_reject_count. These need labels: tenant_id, tier, region, route.
alex: agreed. we'll add headers on generation responses: `x-redwood-variant-used`, `x-redwood-quota-status` (ok|soft|hard). product can use this to show in-app banners.
infra-bot: policy push succeeded to staging (rev 45). Canary routing for 10% tenants in eu-west1.
maria-plat: nice. a couple of open questions: 1) should fallback be per-request or per-conversation? 2) how to surface partial fallbacks (e.g., prefix cached but next tokens use fallback)?
sam-product: product asks per-conversation default, but allow per-request override via API header `x-request-preference: prefer-primary|allow-fallback|strict-primary`.
jon: implement semantics: if header strict-primary + soft quota reached => return 429 with structured error JSON and header `x-redwood-quota-status: soft`. If allow-fallback => route to fallback (and increment percent_fallback telemetry).
sudha: also add server-side alerting: when percent_fallback > 5% for a tenant for 15m, page SRE and notify AE.
alex: console UX notes: show live quota bar, projected end-of-day usage based on rolling 24h tokens, and a little chevron to flip to 'policy details' showing the YAML.
maria-plat: deployment plan: push policy API + telemetry + headers in one PR, enable staging canary, run A/B on 5% prod for 48h, check fallback latency delta and customer-facing error rate.
sam-product: +1. schedule a short design review for the banner copy and opt-out wording.
jon: i'll draft the API spec for the header behavior and error payloads today. alex — can you add telemetry labels and an example grafana dashboard?
alex: on it. I'll add panels: tokens/day, fallback_rate, fallback_latency_delta(95p), quota_warns. Will also add tenant drilldown.
maria-plat: owners: jon (API spec + API tests), alex (telemetry + dashboard), sudha (alert rules), sam-product (UX copy), maria-plat (policy DSL + console mockups). Target: staging canary by next Wed.
sam-product: thanks — will coordinate UX review. :thumbsup:
jon: quick nit — need to decide if soft_quota is per-route or global per-tenant. product preference is global with route exemptions.
sudha: implement hierarchy: global -> tier -> route. store in policy as precedence list.
alex: also adding a debug endpoint for tenants to fetch 'policy decision' for a sample request: includes chosen variant and quota checks. Should be gated to admins.
infra-bot: canary rollout to 5% prod (rev45) started at 2026-03-19T09:12:04Z.
maria-plat: perfect. will follow up with console mockups after jon's spec. Thanks everyone.
